subthemes.name: Teaching models to reason step by step
subthemes.gist: These papers train models to think through problems more carefully by making them work through intermediate steps before answering, using techniques like reinforcement learning and feedback to improve their reasoning.

subthemes.name: Making models smaller and faster without losing power
subthemes.gist: These papers compress large models and make them run quicker by removing unnecessary parts, using distillation and quantization, so they work on regular computers and phones.

subthemes.name: Getting models to follow detailed instructions better
subthemes.gist: These papers improve how well models follow specific instructions and learn from feedback using preference optimization, reinforcement learning, and fine-tuning techniques.

subthemes.name: Scaling up training and making it more efficient
subthemes.gist: These papers study how model performance improves as they get bigger and develop better training recipes using scaling laws, advanced optimization, and novel pretraining approaches.

subthemes.name: Finding and using information from text to answer questions
subthemes.gist: These papers help models search through documents and retrieve relevant facts to answer questions more accurately, combining language models with information retrieval.

subthemes.name: Training models on less data and more smartly
subthemes.gist: These papers improve how efficiently models learn by being strategic about which examples to use for training and creating synthetic data when real examples are scarce.

subthemes.name: Helping models know what they actually know
subthemes.gist: These papers work on making models give honest confidence about their answers and admit uncertainty instead of guessing confidently when they do not actually know.

subthemes.name: Combining multiple models and methods together
subthemes.gist: These papers explore how to merge different models, combine multiple reasoning paths, and use multiple models working together to solve harder problems.

subthemes.name: Understanding how models process language internally
subthemes.gist: These papers study how models work internally—looking at attention patterns, hidden representations, and activation steering to improve performance and explain behavior.

subthemes.name: Teaching models to generate code and formal proofs
subthemes.gist: These papers focus on training models to write working code and mathematical proofs by combining language models with formal verification and specialized reasoning techniques.
